faq_heading: Homes near Alex Hope Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Alex Hope Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Alex Hope Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Alex Hope Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Alex Hope Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Lynn Fripps Elementary (0.6 km south-west), Yorkson Creek Middle School (1.0 km west) and des Voyageurs (1.1 km north-east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Alex Hope Elementary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Alex Hope Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 2 middle, 2 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Lynn Fripps Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is R E Mountain Secondary, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Walnut Grove Secondary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is The King's School (1.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Walnut Grove Secondary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Lynn Fripps Elementary (0.6 km south-west), des Voyageurs (1.1 km north-east), James Kennedy Elementary (1.2 km north), Willoughby Elementary (1.3 km south-west), Richard Bulpitt Elementary (1.5 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is des Voyageurs, 1.1 km north-east of Alex Hope Elementary.
